core_obligations: Choose root-subgroup cosets and prove their global and local connectivity through complete Chevalley generation arguments.
Identify face links and prove the stated bipartite spectral bound by squaring links into abelian Cayley graphs and bounding character sums.
Prove strong explicitness, bounded maximal-face incidence and the simply transitive Chevalley action.
